title: Detecting cardiomyopathies in pregnancy and the postpartum period with an electrocardiogram-based deep learning model
summary: Among 1,807 women, the model’s AUC was 0.92 for LVEF ≤35%, 0.89 for <45%, and 0.87 for <50%; the strict-threshold AUC exceeded natriuretic peptide and clinical-variable comparators. The primary study includes 1,807 Mayo Clinic-system women with ECG and echocardiography; the model was evaluated against LVEF-defined cardiomyopathy and compared with biomarkers and a multivariable clinical model. Retrospective diagnostic evidence, not prospective outcome benefit.
ai_technology: An ECG-based deep-learning model screened for cardiomyopathy in pregnant and postpartum women using 12-lead ECGs.
